selected_problem: Fresh-main semantic repository boundary rejection covered POSIX absolute paths, Windows drive-absolute paths and parent escapes, but still accepted drive-relative Windows forms such as C:outside.js as repo-relative semantic nodes.
decision_basis: The gap is a narrow continuation of the freshly merged repo-boundary invariant and is directly falsifiable without choosing a product architecture.
Existing changeset and federated proposal path policies already reject any Windows drive-prefixed relative form, so this cycle aligns semantic identity with an existing repository sovereignty rule.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained unavailable with transient HTTP 502; this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.

pre_fix_reality.expected: fail closed outside repo-relative path model

change: Semantic graph boundary normalization now rejects any leading Windows drive prefix /^[A-Za-z]:/ rather than only drive prefixes followed by a slash.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: PASS: direct Node reproduction showed C:outside.js was not rejected by the fresh-main predicate.
validation.focused_boundary_predicate: PASS: drive-relative and drive-absolute prefixes are rejected while ordinary repo-relative paths remain accepted.

truth_boundary: This closes Windows drive-relative lexical escapes in the graph-only repo-relative path model. It does not establish filesystem case/Unicode identity, provenance arbitration, parser-grade module semantics, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
